subject: Finalizing renewal paperwork & exhibit reconciliation for BlueLake Therapeutics
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@bluelake-thera.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial redlines + scope uplift — BlueLake renewal

Alex / Lindsay — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I'm attaching the initial redlines to the MSA and a consolidated Exhibit C draft that reflects the 3x capacity uplift you requested and a simplified SKU table. Key points you asked us to confirm: 

- Term: customer asked to move from 12 to 24 months (Redwood asked for 18 as preferred).
- SLA credits: customer prefers a per-incident cap rather than monthly aggregate — see redline on §7.4.
- Data retention: BlueLake asked for 365-day retention; legal wants to keep standard 90-day retention with an exception for audit logs.
- Order form: we've consolidated three smaller SKUs into a single tiered capacity line item (Exhibit C v2).

Action items for us: Laura / Rishi, can you please run through the attached PDF and flag any 'deal-breaker' language? If we can accept the term shift to 24 months with a 12-month early-exit pro rata credit, we can present a single clean MSA and order form for signature next week.

Attachments: [Attachment: BlueLake_MSA_redlines.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: ExhibitC_orderform_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@bluelake-thera.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lindsay Ortiz <lindsay.ortiz@bluelake-thera.com>, procurement@bluelake-thera.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial redlines + scope uplift — BlueLake renewal

Camila — thanks for the materials and the call recap. We reviewed the PDF internally. A couple quick clarifications before we loop procurement formally:

- SLA credits: we would accept a per-incident cap if the aggregate monthly exposure is at least 2x the per-incident amount. I know that's specific, but it helps our risk committee.
- Term: 24 months is our strong preference. Can you confirm if pricing tiers hold for the full 24 month term or if there's an annual repricing clause?
- Data: the 365-day retention is important for our clinical audit needs; would Redwood consider an exhibit-level exception that applies to only audit logs rather than full dataset retention?

Procurement wants a single document to drive signature — happy to receive a near-final MSA + order form via DocuSign once legal clears the redlines.

— Alex
Alex Chen
Director of Product Operations, BlueLake Therapeutics

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Initial redlines + scope uplift — BlueLake renewal

Laura / Priyom / Rishi — forwarding Alex's follow-up (above). Internal ask:

1) Term: BlueLake wants 24 months. Commercially I'm happy to accept if Legal is comfortable with a 12-month pro rata credit on early termination and a 90-day notice period for convenience (their original ask was no notice).
2) Retention: propose trade — Redwood keeps standard 90-day retention for customer data, but we add an Exhibit E narrowly scoped to 'audit logs' with 365-day retention and controls (KMS, access logs).
3) SLA credits: counter-proposal: keep the per-incident cap but set the monthly aggregate to 3x per-incident. That should be easier for our SRE finance math.

Can Laura quick-scan the attached redlines and call out any absolute no-go items? If green, we aim to push the clean MSA to Alex and procurement for signature by next Thu 6/10.

Thanks — Camila

[Quoted message: From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@bluelake-thera.com> | Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0400]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Initial redlines + scope uplift — BlueLake renewal

Camila / team — reviewed the PDF and the Exhibit C draft. Summary of legal takeaways: 

- Term and early exit: acceptable to move to 24 months provided we add a 12-month pro rata refund on pre-paid amounts for convenience termination and keep a 90-day notice window.
- Data retention: approved the Exhibit-level carve for 'audit logs' to 365 days. Need explicit language on access controls and KMS integration (I drafted short paragraph).
- SLA credits: legal is comfortable with per-incident cap + 3x monthly aggregate as long as we preserve the cap on total annual exposure (we'll keep it to < 2x ARR as a hard limit).
- Indemnities and liability: minor redline on §12.1 to tighten the 'willful misconduct' threshold — see attached accepted excerpt.

I've attached the excerpt we can include in the clean MSA. Priyom, once you confirm billing language aligns with finance, I'll produce a clean MSA PDF for signature.

Attachments: [Attachment: MSA_clean_accepted_excerpt.txt (txt)]

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Alex / Lindsay — nice to get this over the line. Short summary of what Legal accepted and next steps: 

- Term: Redwood will agree to a 24-month term. We will include a 12-month pro rata refund for early termination for convenience and a 90-day notice period.
- Data retention: Exhibit E (audit logs) will be 365 days with required KMS + access logging; all other user data remains at our standard 90-day retention.
- SLA credits: accepted per-incident cap + monthly aggregate = 3x per-incident; annual exposure capped at 2x ARR.
- Order form: consolidated Exhibit C in v2 is final; pricing tiers locked for 24 months (no annual repricing).

Attached is the near-final MSA and the order form. Please review quickly; procurement if okay, please sign via DocuSign link below. If procurement needs any final PO or billing fields changed, Priyom will update the order form.
